paper-white.$description: Paper White — Page canvas, card surfaces, button text on dark backgrounds, inverse text in dark sections

ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Primary text, filled CTA buttons, navigation, footer — the only action color in the entire system, near-black not pure #000

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Dark section backgrounds (category bands, video frame borders), elevated dark surfaces

stone.$description: Stone — Secondary body text, muted helper text, subdued list/border accents

driftwood.$description: Driftwood — Tertiary text, icon strokes, subtle borders — warm gray that hints at the brand's earthy content tone

sand.$description: Sand — Link borders at rest, muted borders, decorative dividers — warmest neutral, signals hover-to-reveal interaction

mist.$description: Mist — Light surface tint, input field backgrounds, secondary card surfaces, subtle washes

ash.$description: Ash — Hairline borders, card outlines, divider lines between content blocks

graphite.$description: Graphite — Stronger borders for form fields, table separators, more visible structural dividers

smoke.$description: Smoke — Input text, focused form field borders, higher-emphasis text variant

haffer.$description: Single typeface across the entire system. Custom sans with humanist warmth in the letterforms that counterbalances the achromatic palette. Weight 400 handles body and most UI; weight 500 for subheadings and emphasis; weight 600 reserved for statistics and numerical display. Display sizes (48–60px) at weight 400 with tight tracking carry all emotional weight — bold weight is rarely used because scale does the work instead.
